# 14th Hollin Scouts: summer camp notes

- Dates: Friday 11 July to Sunday 13 July. Arrive from 6pm on Friday.
- Place: Hollin Wood campsite. The site is booked and paid for.
- 22 Scouts and 4 leaders are going.
- Each Scout hands in a medical form. The leaders want them back before camp, but no date is set.
- Sunday pick-up: parents collect either at the site gate at 2pm, or at the scout hall at 4pm after the minibus run. Nobody has decided. The minibus driver would rather use the gate, because the hall run adds an hour to his day.
- The troop treasurer sets what each Scout pays. It is not in these notes.
